caption: The drawing depicts a human figure with medium brown skin, long dark hair, and a beard, attached to a black cross. The figure is shown wearing a cloth draped around the waist, colored with beige and greenish-gray lines. The arms are extended outward and nailed to the horizontal beam of the cross; each hand shows a black circular mark at the wrist, presumably indicating nails, with red marks radiating from the wounds. The torso and legs of the figure display multiple red lines resembling bleeding wounds. The feet are crossed and similarly marked with a single black circular wound and red streaks extending from it. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. The number "26" is written in the lower left corner of the image. The drawing is created using bold, dark outlines and a limited palette primarily featuring beige, black, red, brown, yellow, and greenish-gray tones.
title: Plate 26: Christ Crucified: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
